name: @pgfsm/proto-codegen-plugins
description: The buf CLI plus the protoc-gen-* binaries local.buf.gen.yaml invokes as `local:` plugins for TypeScript output. Not a runtime dependency of any app -- only used to run `npm run generate:local` / `npm run generate:remote` in this package. Generated output is exposed to TS consumers via deno.json's `exports`, not this file.
